infobox.usage: Unlocks the bedroom in apartment 34 on the third floor of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia apartment 34 room key (Conc 34) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms in apartment 34 inside the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Bedroom door in apartment 34 on the third floor of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov.
